tickerText: [TENNIS] Davis Cup Qualifier second-round play begins Sept. 18 as Learner Tien opens USA–Czechia in Prague against Jakub Mensik before Ben Shelton faces Jiri Lehecka, while Canada hosts France in Quebec City with Felix Auger-Aliassime on double duty • [SQUASH] QTerminals Qatar Classic crowns champions Friday in Doha after Victor Crouin ended Paul Coll's title run and Mostafa Asal meets Marwan ElShorbagy in the men's final path • [BADMINTON] Asian Games open in Aichi-Nagoya Sept. 19 with badminton at Ichinomiya starting Sept. 20 as Olympic champion An Se-young and India's 20-player squad head into team week • [PICKLEBALL] Veolia Arizona Open quarterfinals day in Mesa follows Tyson McGuffin's round-of-32 exit as Christopher Haworth and upset pairs chase 1,000 PPA points on PickleballTV and FS2 • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Star Contender Astana hits Sept. 18 with mixed and doubles quarterfinals plus singles round of 32 before evening doubles semis at Martial Arts Palace in Kazakhstan

newsItems.title: Davis Cup Day One Begins
newsItems.excerpt: Second-round Qualifier ties open Sept. 18 as Learner Tien leads the U.S. against Jakub Mensik in Prague, Ben Shelton faces Jiri Lehecka, and Felix Auger-Aliassime anchors Canada versus France in Quebec City.

newsItems.title: Qatar Classic Finals Day
newsItems.excerpt: The Platinum event in Doha concludes Sept. 18 after Victor Crouin toppled defending champion Paul Coll and Mostafa Asal advanced to face Marwan ElShorbagy on the men's side.

newsItems.title: Asian Games Badminton Looms
newsItems.excerpt: Shuttle competition at Ichinomiya runs Sept. 20–29 after the Aichi-Nagoya Games open Sept. 19, with team events first and An Se-young among the stars set for singles defense.

newsItems.title: Arizona Open Quarterfinals
newsItems.excerpt: Friday's Veolia Arizona Open pro quarterfinals in Mesa follow a shaken draw that saw Tyson McGuffin fall in the round of 32 while top seed Christopher Haworth and several upset pairs push for 1,000 PPA points.
